description: Check candidate translations against a plan — placeholders, ICU structure, plural categories, length constraints — and report every problem. Writes nothing, anywhere. A clean result means these candidates would be accepted, but it is not permission to write: apply_translations re-runs every check itself and also verifies the project has not changed since the plan was made.

candidates.description: One entry per plan item you are answering.

key.description: The merged key, exactly as the plan item spells it.

locale.description: The locale this translation is for.

quantity.description: CLDR plural category, for a plural item. Omit for an ordinary one.

planId.description: The planId from prepare_translation_plan, this session.

name: validate_translations
title: Validate candidate translations
